result.summary: Adds unit tests covering SelectionResult::Merge, SelectionResult::GetTotalBumpFees, and OutputGroup::EligibleForSpending in the wallet test suite. The tests verify that algorithm metadata is preserved when merging selection results, that bump fee totals accurately deduct group fee discounts, and that output groups are eligible at exactly the required confirmation depth.
result.problem: These coin selection and eligibility code paths lacked targeted unit tests, leaving boundary conditions and fee calculations susceptible to regressions that mutation testing revealed survived existing tests.
evidence: PR description demonstrates three specific surviving mutants killed by these tests: inverting the MANUAL algorithm check during merge, flipping fee discount subtraction to addition in GetTotalBumpFees, and off-by-one depth check in EligibleForSpending
Commit messages link directly to mutation test reports in bitcoincore.space for coinselection.cpp lines 3700 and 3707
result.changed_since_previous: Added a third unit test in coinselection_tests.cpp checking that OutputGroup::EligibleForSpending accepts outputs at the exact confirmation threshold and rejects them at one confirmation less, killing an off-by-one mutant.
result.card: Adds unit tests in coinselection_tests.cpp and coinselector_tests.cpp to cover SelectionResult::Merge algorithm propagation, SelectionResult::GetTotalBumpFees discount calculations, and OutputGroup::EligibleForSpending confirmation depth boundaries. Existing tests did not verify these behaviors, allowing regressions in algorithm tracking, fee calculation, and coin eligibility to pass CI undetected. The PR demonstrates that the new tests kill three surviving mutants in wallet coin selection logic.

risk.why: Only adds wallet unit test assertions; production code is untouched.
